hard_criteria.pass: The final recipient on the screen and circled paper row both visibly read A-17 and 9,800,000. Every component must be readable together.
hard_criteria.fail: Either account or amount mismatches, is missing, belongs to another row, or is not readable.

hard_criteria.pass: Trace the investigator’s right hand to the held pencil and its sharpened graphite point. That actual point visibly touches the paper at the circled A-17 / 9,800,000 target entry.
hard_criteria.fail: Point touches a different row or nearby paper, hovers, is hidden, or only the shaft crosses the circle. Mere proximity fails. This preserves the previous failed criterion.

hard_criteria.pass: The distinct left hand visibly supports the paper and can be traced to its own forearm while the right hand actuates the pencil.
hard_criteria.fail: Support is absent, ambiguous, transferred to the right hand, or off-frame.

hard_criteria.pass: Visible face and short dark bob with wispy fringe match the reference appearance at the saved scale.
hard_criteria.fail: Appearance is materially different or too obscured to evaluate.

hard_criteria.pass: The screen funds-flow route and deposit statement are jointly understandable as an investigator comparing records.
hard_criteria.fail: Generic office portrait, decorative numbers, or disconnected props fail.

review_rule: Review the actual saved image at native scale and whole-frame scale. Record observability visible/partial/unobservable separately. Partial or unobservable components cannot pass a complete gate. Metadata, prompt audit, retrieval exposure, source credit and user acceptance remain separate.
artistic_observations: Assess whether the exact contact and matching fields dominate enough to explain the moment.
Describe the face’s presence and the overall visual impression before referring to control labels.
source_credit_rule: A feature already present in this frozen baseline gets no new-source credit; later source credit requires an actual literal final-prompt delta and image-grounded material evidence.
